The present appeal is filed by the claimant seeking for enhancement of compensation.
2. The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.

3. Heard the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
4.
The Tribunal has awarded the compensation under various head as follows:
Sl . Heads.
Amount in  No. (Rs.)
1. Loss of earnings 36,000-00  2. Pain and suffering 30,000-00
3 . Loss of amenities 15,000-00  4. Attendant charges 6,000-00
5. Loss of income during laid up 6,000-00  period  6 Medical expenses 13,000-00  Total: 1,06,000-00 5.

From the medical evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had sustained the following injuries:-
NC: 2023:KHC-D:12394 "Comminuted fracture of 1/3rd middle right clavicle,
mal-united fracture of right L-3 transverse process."

sentences.text: The doctor-PW.2 has stated that the claimant had suffered 25% of physical disability.
The Tribunal has taken only 5% has functional disability to whole body is on lesser side.

Hence,
functional disability is taken at 10% considering the nature of injuries sustained.
Claimant may be deaf or dumb but is a mason by profession.
If a person is deaf and dumb, that cannot be considered that he is not earning by doing work of mason.
Mason work is like coolie work and claimant is doing the mason work for his livelihood.
7. The accident is caused in the year 2011 that is on 13.06.2011.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.6,000/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 22 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 18.

Hence, loss of NC: 2023:KHC-D:12394 future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.6,000X10/100X18x12=Rs.1,29,600-00.
8.

Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.40,000-00 towards pain and suffering,
Rs.30,000-00 towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.13,000/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced

;
therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.10,000-00 towards incidental expenses like food,
nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.18,000-00(Rs.6000X3) towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of 3 months, is awarded.

9. Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 40,000-00  suffering.
 2. Towards medical expenses.
Towards loss of amenities.
Towards loss of income during 18,000-00  laid up period and medical  treatment period.

NC: 2023:KHC-D:12394  5. Towards incidental charges like 10,000-00  attendant charges, food,
nourishment, conveyance, etc.,.

6. Towards loss of future earning 1,29,600-00 capacity.
Total: 2,40,600-00 Dadapeer S/O Imamsab Sangoli vs Imamhussain Sangoli on 12 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107349210/
3 10.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.2,40,600-00, along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.1,06,000/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

11. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 08.10.2012, passed by the Fast Track Court and AMACT, Bailhongal, in MVC No.2680/2011 stands modified.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:12394 iii)
The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.2,40,600-00 along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
v) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
vi) No order as to costs.
vii) Draw award accordingly.

SD/-
